evidence: R01-F01 is remediated with the documented CredUIPromptForCredentialsW generic, always-show, non-persisting flag combination; the actual NameSamCompatible current identity is prefilled, UPN uses a NULL LogonUserW domain, down-level/local mapping is preserved, and same-SID enforcement, secret zeroing, and handle RAII remain intact.

R01-F02 is remediated by releasing the supervisor lifecycle mutex during Core I/O, marking and checking per-process cancellation, immediately terminating Core on lock, and validating the live process before returning. Profile and support-bundle changes are staged and published atomically only while the captured application-lock generation still owns the commit boundary; lock clears pending support previews and staging drops on cancellation.

R01-F03 is remediated with listener-before-status registration, monotonic audit-sequence reconciliation, one-second native polling, time-bounded listener/status calls, and synthesized configuration-invalid locking for malformed or failed reconciliation. Stale/conflicting native state cannot reopen a fail-closed renderer; only explicit successful unlock can do so.

R01-F04 is remediated by an RAII native reauthentication reservation acquired under the lock mutex before prompting. Concurrent calls are bounded by one admitted prompt, and cancellation, denial, panic, Core-start failure, and success all release the reservation while retaining exponential backoff.

Deterministic native tests cover concurrent prompt admission, reservation cleanup, a lock racing profile publication, a lock racing support preview/export publication, and an in-flight Core request cancelled without a response. Frontend and browser tests cover malformed, missed, stale, conflicting, failed, and normal-unlock reconciliation from a populated shell.
The exact candidate passes warnings-as-errors, all affected native/frontend/browser/security/contracts/desktop tests, and clean governed build/architecture/evidence checks.

ADR-0018 and the application-lock architecture now state the validated prompt identity mapping, one-at-a-time reauthentication, immediate Core cancellation, staged side-effect publication, pending-preview invalidation, and fail-closed renderer reconciliation behavior implemented by the candidate.
No schema migration, package-version change, new account identity, durable credential, cloud dependency, allowlisted post-lock work, or UI-reference change was introduced.

The prior live dependency scan remains applicable because package versions and the lockfile did not change; the newly activated existing windows-sys API feature is compiled and covered by exact Windows clippy/build/tests plus the security source boundary.
